system: SADEQ P0 B01 API + B02 Store + B05 UAG
objective: Доказать запрет межорганизационного доступа к заявке при подмене tenant в URL, теле и демонстрационном заголовке; отдельно удостоверить отсутствие недозволенных побочных эффектов.

source_refs.application_note: Источник постановки, маршрутов, исходного состояния и наблюдаемых последствий.
Собственные обязательные инварианты авторизации и неявного доверия запретить.
Обосновывает включение конкретных проверок и методик в программу испытаний.
Теоретический контекст делегированных полномочий агента и матрицы capabilities; не нормативное основание HTTP-статуса.

preconditions: Isolated synthetic tenant-a and tenant-b, both have INC-001 with distinguishable data.
Signed tokens from isolated trusted test identity provider with wrong-audience fixtures.
Exact endpoint, status 403 versus masked 404 and ACL policy MUST be frozen before review; draft cannot execute as acceptance.
setup: Store authoritative pre-state digests for tenant-a and tenant-b objects and event counters.
Store zero-state counter of mock ITSM tool invocations and redacted audit start position.
Record candidate git SHA, policy hash, source revision, fixture hash and test environment manifest.

steps.stimulus: Send authenticated tenant-a request for its own INC-001.
steps.expected: Allowed only with server-verified identity, object ACL and approved response fields.

steps.stimulus: Send tenant-a identity to request tenant-b INC-001 using attacker-controlled path/query/header.
steps.expected: The response is denied without foreign content; exact 403 or 404 must be frozen in approved endpoint contract.
observables: HTTP status and response field allowlist
Both tenant DB digests and mock ITSM invocation counter

steps.stimulus: Submit body containing forged tenant_id, role or is_admin fields.
steps.expected: Unknown fields are rejected by closed contract before mutation of any object or audit success receipt.

negative_assertions: No cross-tenant payload, snippet or sensitive fields in any response or trace.
No change to tenant-b state version, event count or object digest.
No unauthorized approval, no UAG tool call and no mock ITSM mutation.
No identity is trusted solely because X-Demo-Tenant or tenant_id was supplied.

evidence_plan.description: Sanitized raw HTTP request and response per step with verification timestamps.
Authoritative tenant A and B before/after snapshot state digests.
Redacted deny decisions with trace references and no secret material.
Independent mock ITSM action call counts, before and after.
Git SHA, policy, schema, fixture and environment hashes bound to run ID.

expected_result: PASS допускается исключительно после выполнения всех согласованных шагов и доказанного отсутствия побочных эффектов; при отсутствии среды или evidence — BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE.
